profile: RxSight develops and commercializes medical technology for customized vision following cataract surgery. Its RxSight Light Adjustable Lens system includes an adjustable intraocular lens, a light delivery device, and related accessories. After lens implantation, eye doctors use the device to adjust the lens based on the patient’s refractive needs, allowing post-surgical changes to the visual correction. The system is used in premium cataract procedures.
